messages:
maria: dropping the compare table update for review. main asks: handle long filter chips, make perf badge legend clearer, and clarify how 'pin version' behaves when exporting compare CSV. TLDR: density + clarity. thoughts?

jake: first glance: chips overflow badly at narrow widths. current approach wraps to two lines and increases row height. can we truncate with a +N indicator and expand on hover/click?

sasha: truncation + tooltip is fine but keyboard users need an expand action. propose a small affordance: "Show all filters (opens tray)" reachable via keyboard. aria-expanded should toggle.

lee: UX copy nit: the +N chip currently says "+3" — ambiguous. maybe "+3 filters" or an icon with aria-label="3 hidden filters".

maria: agree on explicit copy. also thinking of a compact mode toggle for power users so rows can stay single-line. toggle persisted in local storage.

jake: about perf badges: clients asked for an accessible legend. the tiny colored pills don't communicate meaning well on first glance. can we add a legend row above table or a hoverable "i" icon that reads: "Green = p95 < 75ms, Yellow = 75-250ms, Red = >250ms"

sasha: legend is good. for screen reader announce numeric changes using aria-live=polite on rows that update. avoid too many announcements — debounce to 2s.

lee: version pinning + export: when user pins a model version in compare, the CSV currently exports the displayed version but doesn't include a column saying whether that was a pinned version or an ephemeral selection. we should add a column: "version_source": "pinned|selected|latest"

maria: subtle copy debate: should the UI label be "Pin version" or "Lock version"? Lock feels heavier. pin is consistent elsewhere. prefer "Pin version" but microcopy tooltip: "Pin keeps this version as the default in catalog and compare (can be overridden locally)"

jake: suggestion: show a small chained icon on pinned rows indicating global pin. when local override exists, badge shows "override" tooltip. also surface a confirmation toast: "Pinned v1.3.2 for Model X. It will be used as the default in listings."

sasha: keyboard flow: tab order should be: table -> row actions -> pin -> expand compare -> more. current mock traps focus in row action menu. need to audit focus order.

maria: accessibility and visual contrast: the yellow badge color fails WCAG AA on the light background. either darken the yellow or add a 1px dark stroke.

ui-bot: design-review: please add figma link + screenshot of compact mode and legend placement. tag eng for CSV schema change.

maria: action items (short):
- maria: mock compact-mode toggle + tooltip copy + figma link
- jake: implement +N chip pattern and aria-label wording
- sasha: write aria-live debounce pattern and keyboard expand pattern
- lee: propose CSV column name and work with eng to add enum values
- maria: update badge colors to meet contrast and add legend microcopy

maria: ETA: next iteration Thurs EOD. thanks! :raised_hands:
